why_v2_cannot_produce_today: No V2-native token-metrics ingestor exists in v2.backend.app.cli or v2.backend.app.services.
Legacy unified_feature_builder.py wires token_metrics to off-exchange sources (on-chain metrics, sentiment, holder distribution) that are NOT in any v2:* Redis namespace.
V2 ingestor registry (v2:ingestor_registry) currently exposes only Binance, KuCoin, CoinAPI, and CoinAnk feeds; none of those provide the legacy token_metrics 18 dims.

candidates: Operator-provided sentiment aggregator (Glassnode-style, IntoTheBlock-style, or operator-internal)
v2_implementation_outline_if_approved: Add v2/backend/app/cli/v2_token_metrics_ingestor_loop.py (new) that reads operator-approved REST/WebSocket feeds.
Vault-aware secret_decision.py classification for feed credentials.
Extend full_observation_builder to project the 18-dim slice from new v2:market keys.
Add focused tests + Codex review pair.

rationale_for_optionality: Legacy V3 observation defines token_metrics=18 as a non-optional unified_features sub-family (no optional=True flag in obs_schema). However the checkpoint will currently load whichever V3 shape it was trained against. Whether the operator-approved checkpoint requires token_metrics filled is an open operator question; the answer is currently UNKNOWN_METADATA_REQUIRED and depends on the operator-provided checkpoint sidecar.
operator_decision_options: APPROVE_EXTERNAL_TOKEN_METRICS_FEED: provide credentials and V2 ingestor scope; new V2 ingestor + Codex review needed before integration.
DEFER_TOKEN_METRICS: keep token_metrics 18 dims explicit-missing in full_observation_builder until a checkpoint is shown to need them.
EXCLUDE_TOKEN_METRICS: skip permanently and accept the corresponding compatibility limitation in the operator-provided checkpoint metadata.
